rationale: The obligation asks whether the Aldrin row at Outfall 001 establishes any enforceable numeric discharge limitation or only monitoring-and-reporting with no numeric limit for compliance comparison. The packet shows Aldrin with N/A in every numeric limit column (30-DAY AVG, DAILY MAX, and 7-DAY AVG for both mass-loading and concentration columns), while the same table assigns explicit numeric values to other pollutants in those columns (e.g., BOD5: 1669 lbs/day, 2504 lbs/day, 30 mg/L, 45 mg/L). The column headers distinguish those limit columns from MEASUREMENT FREQUENCY and SAMPLE TYPE, where Aldrin instead shows Report, 1/Quarter, and Grab—indicating a quarterly grab monitoring and reporting requirement rather than a numeric cap. Page 3 introductory language confirms the table governs Outfall 001 discharges for the permit term. No numeric limit value appears anywhere in the Aldrin row, so the row establishes monitoring-and-reporting only, not an enforceable numeric discharge limitation. Limitation: the packet does not include a footnote explicitly defining N/A or Report, but the within-table contrast between limit-bearing rows and the Aldrin row provides establishing structural evidence for interpreting this row.
